mapper.sql: i.ISSUE_ID::text AS "issueId", i.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", i.ISSUE_TTL AS "title", i.DDLN_DT AS "dueDate", i.IMPR_CD AS "importanceCode", i.ISSUE_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", i.ACTN_CN AS "actionText", i.REG_USER_ID AS "assigneeId", COALESCE(u.USER_NM,i.REG_USER_ID) AS "assigneeName", i.REG_USER_ID AS "createdBy", i.REG_DTTM AS "createdAt", i.MOD_USER_ID AS "updatedBy", i.MOD_DTTM AS "updatedAt", COALESCE(u.USER_NM,i.REG_USER_ID) AS "createdByName", COALESCE(mu.USER_NM,i.MOD_USER_ID) AS "updatedByName", COALESCE(i.MOD_DTTM,i.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt", CASE WHEN i.ISSUE_STAT_CD!='CLOSE' THEN GREATEST(0,CAST(#{today} AS date)-i.DDLN_DT) ELSE 0 END AS "overdueDays"
FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=i.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=i.REG_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER mu ON mu.USER_ID=i.MOD_USER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT i.PROJ_ID FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i WHERE i.ISSUE_ID=#{issueId}
SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT i.ISSUE_ID FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i WHERE i.ISSUE_ID=#{issueId} AND i.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.CODE_NM FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID=#{group} AND c.CODE=#{code} AND c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('SQ_TB_PJ_ISSUE')
INSERT INTO TB_PJ_ISSUE (ISSUE_ID,PROJ_ID,ISSUE_TTL,IMPR_CD,DDLN_DT,ISSUE_STAT_CD,ACTN_CN,REG_USER_ID,REG_DTTM) VALUES (#{issueId},#{input.projectId},#{input.title},#{input.importanceCode},#{input.dueDate}, #{input.statusCode},#{input.actionText},#{actor},clock_timestamp())
